profile_text.body:
Wix.com Ltd. is a publicly traded company, listed under the ticker WIX with CIK 0001576789, headquartered in Tel Aviv. Its own site presents it as a website builder: a free, easy-to-use tool for creating a website, offering more than 2,000 templates, a custom domain, and built-in AI tools. The company also says users can sell products, services, and memberships from a single dashboard without plugins.

On AI, the site's claims are limited to built-in AI tools in the builder and what it calls specialized AI agents for keeping a business growing. No specific AI products, model names, or research efforts are described in the material available.

The record holds no litigation and no tracked products for the company.
